answers.core: This is a change to something that **is** core.
answers.workaround:
Dictionary is a core datatype, so it is used **very** often, and with changes to its inspector UX it could be used even more for resource/scene property serialization.

Another requested engine feature is [typed dictionaries](56). If this proposal gets implemented, then from the exported side they can **already** become typed! (*or without some extra work, at least lose the inconveniences of generic ones*)

title: Streamline editing of Dictionaries in Inspector
